extension.description: Coordinate multiple AI coding agents from one workspace.
configuration.hub.url: Prometheon Hub base URL. HTTPS is required outside `localhost`. Leave it empty to work locally only. Tokens do **not** go here: they go to the VS Code secret storage.
configuration.chat.defaultType.local: Local Chat: works without an account and without a server.
configuration.chat.defaultType.web: Web Chat: requires a configured Prometheon Hub.
configuration.workspace.promptOnOpen: Show the setup screen when the open folder has no .prometheon/prometheon.yaml.
